changedBehavior: Verified installed copies use one Update now action from Settings or About; update checks run at startup and every ten minutes, About status/details are compact, and the delivered installer handoff outcome is shown after reopening.
expectedAssertions: Installed copies expose a single Update now action in both Settings and About; it confirms once, downloads/verifies, then uses the #666 handoff with relaunch enabled.
Cancellation, tamper or download failure never runs Setup; portable and unverified copies keep ZIP/manual replacement.
The first automatic update check runs at startup and later checks use a ten-minute completion-based cadence without overlap, while failures retain any confirmed release.
About shows one status sentence, relative Last checked and the action; exact timestamps/deployment diagnostics live in collapsed Update details.
The next launch reports Updated to the target or explicit recovery from #666 durable outcome evidence, without popup or forced navigation.
